category_title: Latino students whose disruptive or defiant behavior is interpreted as 'uncharacteristic'
minimal_context: The student is participating in a language arts lesson while seated near a second-story window overlooking the recess yard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are in the middle of our language arts lesson. Please turn to the next page and begin reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits at his desk near the second-story window, looking out at the kindergarten class playing at recess in the yard below.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please focus on the reading assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Picks up a heavy metal pencil sharpener dispenser from near his desk instead of looking at the language arts assignment.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Put that down and get back to work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws the heavy metal pencil sharpener dispenser out the second-story window, narrowly missing a cluster of kindergartners playing in the yard below, and then immediately looks "scared and sorry".)
